M007.label: afflicted
M007.quote: Because of the strong martian and saturnine influences on the 8th 22nd Drekkana, Gandhi, an apostle of non-violence, had a 'violent end.
M007.note: He was shot dead in Sun Bhukti of Jupiter Dasa.

M015.label: none
M015.note: The Ramakrishna section (NH 6836-6970) says nothing about his father.

M023.label: mixed
M023.quote: side by side with powerful Dhana yogas, there are combinations approximating to Rajabhanga Neecha yogas
M023.note: He became ruler of a premier State (Rajayoga) but Venus later 'deprived the Nizam of power and prestige', with humiliation and loss of position.

M031.label: afflicted
M031.quote: The 7th house is equally afflicted; not in the sense of his not deriving happiness from his wives but in regard to loss of wives.

M039.label: favourable
M039.quote: Shaw's mother was a powerful factor in his life and the Moon's presence in Lagna accounts for this. The benefic disposition of Matrukaraka gave good longevity to his mother.

M047.label: none
M047.note: Raman only times the event ('In Saturn's sub-period his father died') and gives no age or judgment of early loss.

M055.label: afflicted
M055.quote: The native was in her second year when her father died in Saturn Dasa, Jupiter Bhukti.

M063.label: afflicted
M063.quote: In Jupiter Dasa, Roosevelt's father died when he was eighteen. Mark the position of Jupiter in the 9th from Lagna with Saturn.
M063.note: A dated fact (father died when the native was 18) with a pointer to the affliction, not an explicit verdict.

M071.label: favourable
M071.quote: Mercury as the intellectual planet is between the Sun and Mars revealing the native's political doctrines. His intellectual output in prison was prodiguous.
M071.note: A brief remark inside a general discussion of authorship.

M079.label: afflicted
M079.quote: resulted in two marriages. Married life was unhappy.

M087.label: afflicted
M087.quote: Putrakaraka Jupiter is afflicted. The 5th is a malefic sign and is occupied by a malefic planet. ... This explains his having only one daughter.
M087.note: The progeny is limited, not denied.

M095.label: favourable
M095.quote: The house of intelligence is well fortified.
M095.note: He also notes Sun-Mercury giving 'great mental abilities' and 'excellent faculties of reflection reasoning and analysis'.

M103.label: afflicted
M103.quote: The commencement of the Sun Dasa therefore saw him in prison.
M103.note: Repeated imprisonments are recounted (Sun Dasa, end of Rahu Bhukti, Moon Dasa Mercury Bhukti).

M111.label: mixed
M111.quote: did not give him good longevity ... his untimely death in the prime of life ... the end was certainly peaceful, as the 8th house is completely free from affliction.
M111.note: Short life (afflicted) but a peaceful manner of death (favourable).

M119.label: afflicted
M119.quote: The house of mother being afflicted considerably by Rahu indicates protection under a foster-mother during the period of Rahu.

M127.label: mixed
M127.quote: enabled the native to earn considerable wealth but Saturn in the 2nd made him spend (of course on good purposes) all his earnings without saving anything.

M135.label: favourable
M135.quote: The native will have brothers. The third lord Saturn is in the 2nd Navamsha. The native will therefore have only two brothers (including himself).
M135.note: Brothers are promised but limited ('only two, including himself'); a case for mixed could be made.

M143.label: favourable
M143.quote: The native, an heir to a large estate, being the son of a newspaper-magnate, and himself involved in it, his fortune too bloomed in the country of his birth.

M151.label: afflicted
M151.quote: In spite of the wealth and the great qualities of head and heart he possessed, the Maharaja was not happy so far as marriage life was concerned.

M159.label: afflicted
M159.quote: Only one daughter was born just at the beginning of Ketu Dasha and she is living. That apart the native has had no issues.
M159.note: Raman says children are 'not denied' but only one was born; the progeny is limited.

M167.label: mixed
M167.quote: the 5th is considerably afflicted by the position of Ketu and the aspect of Mars and Saturn. He had five children but was not very happy

M175.label: afflicted
M175.quote: The chart is more significant for the prison-terms the native underwent during the Indian Independence days. It was Rahu's Dasa and part of Jupiter's Dasa that the native was arrested several times.

M183.label: favourable
M183.quote: The native was a big industrialist and was one of the wealthiest Indians.
M183.note: He also writes 'all ideal combinations denoting "immense wealth"'.

M191.label: mixed
M191.quote: Since the 9th lord is afflicted together with the Sun, the father cannot live very long. But the position of the 9th lord in a kendra in a beneficial constellation cannot deprive the native of her father very early in life either.
M191.note: The father died in 1973, when the native was about 23.

M199.label: afflicted
M199.quote: The native has only one daughter. Mark, while the 5th house is fairly well disposed, the 5th lord Saturn and PutraKaraka are both considerably afflicted
M199.note: He also notes miscarriages and premature births.

M207.label: favourable
M207.quote: The Nizam is noted for his fabulous wealth and this is shown by a number of Dhana yogas

M215.label: mixed
M215.quote: The native will have a fair complexion, middle-sized stature and handsome appearance. ... the native suffered seriously from typhoid and malarial fevers. ... Moon, Mars, Rahu association denotes emotional upsets.
M215.note: The Lagna, its lord and the Sun are each judged 'fairly' strong; the conclusion then gives both good and bad results.

M223.label: afflicted
M223.quote: The 7th lord afflicted by Rahu and Mars gave a disgusting husband who was at once stupid and stubborn.
M223.note: Widowhood followed in Saturn Dasa Saturn Bhukti.

M231.label: favourable
M231.quote: This combination brought him good reputation and wide influence and made him an authority not only in astrology but in the Indian sciences and history as well.
M231.note: Also: 'Rahu, Jupiter and Saturn built up his career and gave him international reputation' (line 7080).

M239.label: favourable
M239.quote: Sri Thyagaraja is a household name in South India and he occupies a pre-eminent place amongst the great masters of South Indian music.
M239.note: Raman also notes his indifference to worldly affluence and royal patronage.

M247.label: favourable
M247.quote: Lord of Lagna ideally placed and not involved in any sort of affliction with either Rahu or Mars ... conferred humility, gentleness and forbearance and charming manners.
M247.note: Closing line: 'Einstein was undoubtedly one of the greatest mankind has ever produced' (line 9892).

M255.label: afflicted
M255.quote: Chart No. 118 is the horoscope of a lady and her trouble is paralysis of the limbs and arms.

M263.label: mixed
M263.quote: Self-made, he has risen to a very high position in life after much struggle. ... The Moon being hemmed in between Mars and Saturn makes the mind worried almost always.
M263.note: A high position was won after struggle, but the mind is worried, wavering and pessimistic; favourable is also arguable.

M271.label: mixed
M271.quote: the native inherited a royal throne in Rahu Bhukti of Saturn Dasa. ... the gains acquried during Saturn's Dasa could not last long and the native had to abdicate the throne

M279.label: none
M279.note: The Sivananda section reads the 4th house only for education; it says nothing about his mother.

M287.label: favourable
M287.quote: The afflictions result in temperamental clashes but the presence of Saturn in the 7th and Jupiter and Venus in mutual aspect result in a stable marriage with deep attachment between the couple.
M287.note: The cited Chart 210 passage is about elder siblings only. The same birth data is Chart 1 (HTJAH-II line 1009), where the marriage is judged; it is two-sided but concludes a stable marriage.

M295.label: mixed
M295.quote: These yogas enabled the native to emerge as a powerful industrialist during Mercury's Dasa ... As soon as Ketu Dasa began, the native's financial empire came crashing down.

M303.label: afflicted
M303.quote: Since the first house planet is a malefic and since he is in conjunction With the Moon, the native will not be quite healthy.
M303.note: He adds that such a Lagna lord confers a weak constitution.

M311.label: favourable
M311.quote: The aesthetic Venus, placed in Gemini, the second house, made Tennyson one of the greatest masters of poetic workmanship, the world has ever known.
M311.note: The H2 judgment is about poetic expression; elsewhere he notes Tennyson was sometimes 'scarcely intelligible'.

M319.label: afflicted
M319.quote: Enormous losses and enormous troubles for the native of the above horoscope coincided with the commencement of Rahu Dasha. ... The man is involved in huge debts.
